description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to the mobility management component of a CU-CP in a 5G network, including measurement handling, metrics reporting, and handover procedures.

classes.name: mobility_manager_measurement_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling measurement events related to neighbor cell improvements.

classes.name: mobility_manager_metrics_handler
classes.description: Interface for capturing and reporting mobility management metrics.

classes.name: mobility_manager
classes.description: Implements mobility management including handovers, metrics, and event handling.

methods.name: mobility_manager::trigger_handover
methods.description: Initiates a handover from source to target cell.

methods.name: mobility_manager::trigger_conditional_handover
methods.description: Initiates a conditional handover with a timeout and optional override.

methods.name: mobility_manager::handle_neighbor_better_than_spcell
methods.description: Handles event when neighbor cell becomes better than serving cell.

methods.name: mobility_manager::get_metrics_handler
methods.description: Returns the metrics aggregator for reporting.
